automatedTests.status: Windows passed; Linux completed with failures in the aggregate Python target. No complete Linux pass is claimed.
automatedTests.environment: WSL Git wrapper translates only this Windows-managed worktree for read-only metadata; temporary test repositories use native Git unchanged. Meson timeout multiplier 4 accommodates DrvFS packaging I/O.

analysis: 115 failure reports compile standalone fixtures for host x86_64 rather than required Linux i686.
An Elite Force environment-map fixture omits the math library link.
Other reports include ET reference target selection, ET LOD precision, ET precompiler host execution, and unavailable POSIX chmod semantics on DrvFS.
One packaging subtest captured the tracked-file list before a new evidence document was added during the run; its older staged copy could not resolve the new link.

limitations: Linux dedicated-server evidence only; no Linux client or non-x86 claim.
Broader installations, complete renderer parity and subjective listening/device coverage remain open.
Development gate remains enabled; not a release compatibility declaration.
safety: Windowed clients; mouse/joystick disabled and no input injection or OS capture.
Only independent asset copies and isolated writable homes under E:/Games/fnTech3-tests.
Local UDP relay observes only these sessions; random test RCON passwords and client GUIDs omitted.
No proprietary assets, screenshots or demos included.
